objective_for_doctor: Evaluate a 67-year-old woman with a change in mental status and abdominal discomfort.

turns.doctor_opening: Hello, what brings you in today? Could you tell me about yourself and what's been going on?
turns.patient_opening: Doctor: Hello, what brings you in today? Could you tell me about yourself and what's been going on? Patient: I’m confused lately and I can’t really explain what I feel very well. I’ve also had a fever around 102°F and discomfort when you press on my right upper belly area.

turns.doctor_question: Do you have any small, raised bumps on your skin that have a tiny indentation or a "dimple" in the center?
turns.patient_answer: I haven’t noticed any small, raised bumps with a dimple in the center on my skin. I’ve mainly felt more confused, had a fever around 102°F, and I’m uncomfortable when my right upper belly is pressed.

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed that you need to urinate more often than usual?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed needing to urinate more often than usual. My main issue has been feeling more confused, having a fever around 102°F, and discomfort when my right upper belly is pressed.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you been feeling generally weak or lacking your usual strength lately?
turns.patient_answer: Doctor: Have you been feeling generally weak or lacking your usual strength lately? Patient: Yes, I’ve felt weaker than usual, and my confusion has been getting worse. I’m not back to how I was before this started.

turns.doctor_question: Have you been experiencing any difficulty with dressing yourself or putting on your clothes lately?
turns.patient_answer: “Yes, I’ve been having more trouble dressing myself and managing my clothes, and I feel too weak and confused to do it like I used to.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any rashes, bumps, or sores appearing specifically along the veins in your arms?
turns.patient_answer: Patient: No, I haven’t noticed any rashes, bumps, or sores along the veins in my arms. I mainly feel more confused, have had a fever around 102°F, and it hurts when you press on my right upper belly.

turns.doctor_question: Have you been experiencing any itchiness on your skin?
turns.patient_answer: No, I haven’t noticed any itchiness on my skin. I’ve mostly just been increasingly confused, had a fever around 102°F, and it’s uncomfortable when my right upper belly is pressed.

turns.doctor_question: Do you experience any pain or cramping in your calf muscles while walking that goes away once you stop and rest?
turns.patient_answer: I haven’t noticed any calf pain or cramping when I try to walk, and it doesn’t seem related to walking or stopping to rest. My main problems have been getting more confused, feeling weaker, having a fever around 102°F, and discomfort when my right upper belly is pressed.

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed if your stools have become unusually pale, light-colored, or clay-colored recently?
turns.patient_answer: “I’m not sure what my stools have looked like recently, since I’ve been too confused and weak to pay close attention, but I haven’t noticed any obvious clays or very pale colors. My main concerns are the fever around 102°F, the increasing confusion, and the discomfort when you press my right upper belly.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any weakness in your hands, such as difficulty gripping objects or opening jars?
turns.patient_answer: Patient: Yes, I’ve had more trouble gripping things and doing up my clothes; my hands feel weaker than they used to. I’m also getting more confused and it’s been hard for me to manage day-to-day tasks.

turns.doctor_question: During these shaking episodes, are you able to remain conscious and aware of your surroundings, or do you lose consciousness?
turns.patient_answer: Patient: I’m not usually able to stay fully aware—sometimes I feel very disoriented and it’s hard to follow what you’re saying. I don’t think I fully pass out, but I do lose track of my surroundings at times.
